rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance – Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.requirement: Landlords of units covered by the Rent Ordinance may raise rent annually by no more than the allowable percentage set by the Rent Board. The rate for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.status_basis: Existing Rent Ordinance; the page publishes the current annual allowable increase.

rules.title: San Francisco Rent Board – Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at the rate set by the Rent Board. The rate for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 is 4.2%.
rules.status_basis: Page publishes the current annual interest rate; underlying law not cited.

rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance – Eviction Relocation Payments (Sections 37.9A and 37.9C)
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation to each tenant, and Ellis Act evictions carry separate higher payments. Temporary displacement under 20 days is paid per day plus moving expenses.
rules.key_value: Sec. 37.9C for notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27: $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child; Ellis Act (37.9A): $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant; temporary displacement under 20 days: $446/day plus actual moving expenses
rules.status_basis: Existing Rent Ordinance sections; page publishes current amounts by date of service of notice.
